mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0% in a month), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by at least 1% from the prior month, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 120.0), the supply chain is robust and corporate margins are stable, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 120.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and residential investment, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1% from the prior month, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary policy tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
